R1C-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Keogh River
R1C-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
26 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-08-24): get permission first or go around.
Private land right here: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue) and ruffed only; 5 each (15 each); no open season on Denman Island (page 20)
sooty (blue) and ruffed; Bow Only; 5 each (15 each); no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from District of Port Hardy, about 31 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 19 (Island Hwy), Hwy 30, Westmain.
Park: 50.53876, -127.22691, pull off on Westmain (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Wm100 stretch, 3.8 km one way. About 76 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-13, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-08-24, closures 2026-10-16.
